assertion_audit.failure_condition: The isolated home does not contain all fifty live fixture pointers.
Admission does not launch the queued identity exactly once.
Reinstate unconditional _recorded_backlog: the instrument records the fifty fleet runs and queued run instead of at most the queued run.
Reinstate queued backlog recording: unreconciled_override becomes a populated mapping instead of None.
Admission drops or rewrites the admitted_from request identity.
The persisted argv diverges from the argv actually handed to the capturing launcher; this asserts output consistency, not independent base equivalence.
Direct dispatch skips backlog collection, changes its source, omits an owned overdue run or includes a peer run; expected IDs come from independently seeded fixture membership.
Classifier instrumentation misses any fixture run or direct dispatch no longer exercises the fleet classifier; this is the positive control for the zero admission count.
The changed dispatch computes queued backlog or the immutable base no longer yields the independently seeded ten-run backlog; the recorded mutation fails the first assertion.
The changed preparation path alters any captured launch input besides backlog compared with execution of preparation.py read from the immutable base commit.
Launch serialization fails to retain None for changed admission backlog or the baseline ten-run backlog.
The different backlog inputs affect another returned record or live pointer field when replayed through the unchanged launch owner with fixed clock and worktree.
Either launch replay fails to call the launcher exactly once, or backlog input changes the generated command.

assertion_independence: No added assertion is justified as a regression guard solely by echoing a supplied expected value; line 79 is a consistency check, with independent preparation comparison at line 176 and immutable-base restoration control at lines 174-175. The final records and argv comparisons intentionally share the unchanged launch owner, so they protect the effect of the changed preparation inputs rather than freezing unrelated launch internals.
